follow-up time: From diagnosis of preeclampsia until delivery
outcome: Interval between preeclampsia diagnosis and delivery
cohort: 94 women with preeclampsia (out of 2904 women with singleton pregnancies) who delivered after 22 gestational weeks.
finding: A higher protein:creatinine (P/C) ratio at delivery in women with preeclampsia was associated with an increased risk of early preterm birth and central serous chorioretinopathy.
